ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Persistence Via VMwareToolBoxCmd.EXE VM State Change Script
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of the "VMwareToolBoxCmd.exe" with the "script" and "set" flag to setup a specific script to run for a specific VM state

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\VMwareToolBoxCmd\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "toolbox\-cmd\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ script\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ set\\ .*")))
